biography.plain_text: Lorraine Gardner Sommer, known as Lori, is an American philanthropist and trustee of the James J. and Joan A. Gardner Family Foundation. Her father was a Cintas executive, and her mother was a sister of its chairman, Richard Farmer. She has served alongside her siblings in the family's charitable organisation.

long_biography.plain_text:
Lori Sommer's work with Orlando Health has combined financial giving with hospital volunteering. She served on its foundation board and volunteered in several departments at Orlando Regional Medical Center. Her family's foundation pledged USD 500,000 towards expanding the hospital's Level One Trauma Center in 2017.

In Cincinnati, she was among the family members associated with the foundation's gift for the Gardner Family Grove and Rose Garden at Smale Riverfront Park. The project honoured her father, who had learned rose cultivation from his own father. The family had planned the garden as a surprise for him before his death.
